caption: The dial of an electric stove burner is turned off, and the red-hot coil's glow dims.

sa.check: An electric stove with a coil burner glowing red.
The burner's dial is turned to off.
The coil is glowing before the dial is turned.
The order is glowing, turn, dimming.

pc.expect: The glow begins to fade after the dial is turned, and not before.
pc.fail: The dial is turned and the coil stays at full glow to the end of the clip; or the coil begins to fade before the dial is touched; or the coil brightens after the dial is turned; or the glow goes out instantly like a lamp at the turn.

pc.expect: The fade runs one way, from bright through dull red toward dark, and never brightens again; it is gradual, not a switch-off.
pc.fail: The glow brightens again after dimming; or goes dark and returns; or pulses; or the coil turns from red to a brighter colour.

pc.expect: The fade starts at the coil's outer parts or evenly and does not skip about; the whole coil follows the same one-way change.
pc.fail: One part of the coil goes dark while another brightens; or the glow jumps between segments; or the glow moves along the coil like a travelling light.

pc.expect: The stove and anything on it stay still as the dial is turned; the coil does not move.
pc.fail: The coil lifts or shifts at the turn; or a pan on the stove slides; or the dial turns back by itself.

pc.expect: One coil on one stove; the coil keeps its spiral shape; the hand passes through nothing.
pc.fail: The coil vanishes rather than going dark; or a second coil appears glowing; or the coil changes shape or melts; or the hand passes through the dial or stove.

pc.expect: The stove top's colour, the other burners and the surroundings stay the same apart from the glow.
pc.fail: The stove changes colour; or another burner lights or goes out; or items on the counter rearrange.

note: How fast the glow fades and how far it has faded by the end are not judged, only that it fades one way after the turn.
